description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Lich and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Lich, and lose life equal to their life totals due to Lich's effect.
You cannot lose the game due to having 0 or less life due to Platinum Angel.
Activate Tranquil Grove by paying {1}{G}{G}, destroying all other enchantments.
Each opponent's Lich triggers, causing them to lose the game.
